sections.heading: The Mandate: $130M by 2030
sections.narrative: Achieving our revenue target requires a bifurcated strategy. We must protect our existing Alternative Cloud Provider (ACP) and Managed Service Provider (MSP) base against pricing pressure from hyperscalers and vendors like Wasabi, while aggressively penetrating the cloud-native and AI infrastructure markets. We win on bundled economics, multi-tenant sovereignty, and proven performance.
sections.quote: "Data readiness is the main factor contributing to the gap between AI ambition and AI achievement... over half of organizations report that their data is not AI-ready." - Gartner, 2024

sections.heading: Market Calibration (2026-2027)
sections.narrative: Our Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM) is strictly calculated at 15% of the global Total Addressable Market (TAM), representing the specific ACP/MSP segments where we compete, entirely excluding captive hyperscaler workloads.

sections.heading: The GTM Shift: Benchmark-as-a-Service (BaaS)
sections.narrative: We must change our sales motion. Instead of competing on static datasheets against hyperscaler marketing budgets, we propose launching Benchmark-as-a-Service. Using our continuous internal benchmarking dataset, an Agentic AI will allow customers to input their exact workload requirements and instantly receive a validated reference architecture.

sections.heading: Appendix: Architecture, Objections & Proofs
sections.narrative: Detailed technical defenses, R&D insights, and market validation backing the 2026-2027 strategic roadmap.
experimental_insights: Concept: Data Versioning (LakeFS-style) natively integrated at the Virtuozzo S3 backend.
Mechanism: Zero-copy branching allows petabyte-scale AI training datasets to be versioned instantaneously using metadata pointers rather than physical duplication.
Strategic Value: Enables 'CI/CD for Data'. Data engineers can rollback corrupted AI training states and run parallel experiments without exploding MSP storage costs.

qa_pairs.q: How do we prevent the BaaS Agentic AI from hallucinating unsupported architectures?
qa_pairs.a: Strict RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) grounding. The agent is hard-coded to only query our CI/CD pipeline's validated benchmark datasets. It has zero free-form architectural speculation capabilities.

qa_pairs.q: Does GPUDirect force our MSPs to upgrade their entire network fabric?
qa_pairs.a: No. The GPU-optimized tier is explicitly targeted at dedicated AI compute clusters utilizing RoCEv2 or InfiniBand, which are already standard in those environments. Standard tenants remain on the traditional TCP stack.

qa_pairs.q: Why invest in a bare-metal CSI driver when Ceph is open-source?
qa_pairs.a: Ceph's operational complexity destroys MSP margins by requiring dedicated storage engineers. Our CSI driver is operator-friendly, automating NVMe caching and garbage collection to drastically reduce Day-2 OPEX.
